mechanism: Piroxicam inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis and reduces haloperidol clearance; both drugs increase risk of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and extrapyramidal side effects; NSAIDs increase gastric bleeding risk when combined with antipsychotics.
action: Monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, and GI bleeding; consider alternative analgesic; use lowest effective doses; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
